title: Unique derived extension of ordinary support comparison
statement: In the setting of [def-pur-integral-support-comparison-data], let B be any fixed Ordinary normalized comparison record. There exists exactly one Derived record over B, with the termwise open and proper comparison maps, exact open localization equation and universal proper right-derived-unit equation prescribed by B. The Ordinary record is a parameter; this statement makes no assertion of its existence.

source.place: Outer Hom comparisons and final unit/counit paragraph; canonical comparison specified by Zheng Constructions 4.1 and 5.15, Lemma 4.10, and the universal-unit characterization in integralExceptionalComparison_characterization.

proof.text: For the given Ordinary record B, apply B.openExtension.hom and B.properPush.inv termwise. Their naturality with respect to differentials makes chain maps with exactly the components specified in Derived.

Combine the exact-coordinate and open-extension localization factorizations and the termwise open comparison. Fully faithful precomposition by Q lifts the resulting isomorphism uniquely to derivedOpen and yields derivedOpen_factors.

The exact coordinate equivalences preserve K-injectives and transport universal right-derived pairs. Compare the two resulting right-derived pairs using the inverse ordinary properPush comparison. Universal uniqueness gives derivedProper and exactly the specified derivedProper_unit equation.

Chain-map extensionality fixes openComplex and properComplex. Localization extensionality fixes derivedOpen; right-derived extensionality against its universal unit fixes derivedProper. Proof irrelevance identifies the remaining fields and the Derived records.
